findings.quoted_text: 9.1.1 The Liability Cap will not apply to any (1) material confidentiality breach under Section 5, and/or (2) indemnification obligations under Section 7.1.

findings.explanation: The client can terminate the agreement immediately without giving you an opportunity to fix an alleged food safety issue.
findings.suggested_change: If the default is by Supplier that creates an immediate public food safety risk, PNC may terminate this Agreement if such risk is not corrected within a reasonable time after written notice.

findings.quoted_text: 9.1.1 The Liability Cap will not apply to any (1) material confidentiality breach under Section 5, and/or (2) indemnification obligations under Section 7.1.
findings.explanation: Excluding confidentiality breaches and broad indemnification obligations from the liability cap exposes you to potentially unlimited financial risk.
findings.suggested_change: The Liability Cap shall apply to all claims and liabilities arising under this Agreement, including indemnification.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, excluding confidentiality breaches and broad indemnification obligations from the liability cap exposes us to potentially unlimited financial risk; therefore, I suggest updating it so that the liability cap shall apply to all claims and liabilities arising under this agreement, including indemnification. I look forward to moving forward once these points are addressed. Best regards,
